pie: n̥bʰrós wódr̥ déh₃t. wódr̥ stéh₂dʰh₁om h₂életi. stéh₂dʰh₁om dṓm h₂életi. h₁yód n̥bʰrós h₁r̥sḱéti déh₂nu pléh₁dʰeti. h₁yód n̥bʰrós ne gʷm̥yéti léymō térst ǵʰwḗres-kʷe tr̥syónti.
english: The rain-cloud gives water. Water nourishes the herd. The herd nourishes the house. The river fills when the rain-cloud arrives. When no rain-cloud comes, the lake dries up, and the beasts are thirsty.

pie: h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ gʷʰért h₃mígʰleh₂ tinéh₁ti. sóh₂wl̥ h₂erh₃wṓd h₁éwseti ǵʰwḗres-kʷe swidyónti. h₁yód h₂énh₁mos gʷʰért h₁ógʷʰis sérpeti.
english: When the sun grows warm, the mist melts. The sun burns the arable land, and the beasts sweat. When the wind grows warm, the snake creeps.

pie: h₁yód gʷówes légʰyonti n̥bʰrós gʷm̥yéti. h₁yód h₁éḱwōs tr̥ménti pérkʷunos h₁r̥sḱéti. h₁yód súHes bʰebʰih₂ḗr h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti. h₁yód wĺ̥kʷos HréwdHti nókʷts stéwdt.
english: When the cattle lie down, the rain-cloud comes. When the horses tremble, Perkwunos arrives. When the pigs are afraid, the wind blows. When the wolf cries out, the night grows cold.

pie: stéh₂dʰh₁om kólHonm̥ h₂éǵōmes. nu léymō h₂én h₁ésti. nu suHnús stéh₂dʰh₁om sékʷētor bʰréh₂tēr-kʷe péh₂seti. népot memn̥té. mē h₃sléydʰs.
english: Let us drive the herd to the hill. There is a lake there. The son will follow the herd, and the brother will stand guard. Grandson, remember! Do not go astray.

pie: dʰh₂bʰre h₁ólom gʷʰr̥nudʰí. h₁ólom ph₂wéni h₃roǵéye. péh₂wr̥ dʰégʷʰeti dʰh₂bʰre stunddʰí. h₁ólos h₁wésus dʰh₂bʰrósyo ḱléwos méǵh₂.
english: Smith, heat the awl! Straighten the awl in the fire! The fire is burning, strike, smith, strike! The awl is good, the smith's fame is great.

pie: h₂wérst. nu poh₂imḗn stéh₂dʰh₁om h₂éǵrom ne h₁élh₂t. nu gʷowsth₂óy légʰyont. h₂Hséh₂i sédt h₂ólut-kʷe píph₃et. péh₂wr̥ dʰégʷʰome. nu gʷḗn h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m uh₁inéHt. nu n̥bʰrós léytt.
english: It rained. The herdsman did not drive the herd to the pasture. They were lying in the cow-stall. He sat at the hearth and drank beer. The fire was burning. Then the woman twisted the wool. The rain-cloud went away.

pie: kʷís gʰóstey túH? nu h₁eǵóh₂ poh₂imḗn. kúdʰe gʷéms? péruns gʷḗm. twóm stéh₂dʰh₁om méǵh₂? nu méne stéh₂dʰh₁om méǵh₂. h₂éǵros térst. gʰóstey méne h₂éǵrom h₁r̥sḱé h₁édomes-kʷe.
english: Stranger, who are you? I am a herdsman. Where did you come from? I came from the mountain. Is your herd large? My herd is large. The pasture has dried up. Go to my pasture, stranger, and let us eat.

pie: poh₂imnés stéh₂dʰh₁om méǵh₂. swós h₁éḱwos HeHḱús. ǵʰwḗr swā́s h₂ówins ne lémbʰt. nu swóm h₁wésu ḱléwos h₁syéh₁t swóm-kʷe ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos h₁syéh₁t.
english: The herdsman's herd is great. His own horse is swift. A beast did not seize his sheep. May his fame be good, and may his fame be imperishable!

pie: h₁yód pérkʷunos bʰéh₂ti dʰéǵʰōm wódr̥ píph₃eti. pérkʷunos péh₂wr̥ nébʰesos Hyéh₁kt. pérkʷune nébʰos gléwbʰe n̥sméy-kʷe n̥bʰróm dh₃dʰí. dyéw ph₂ter h₂wr̥syéh₁t.
english: When Perkwunos speaks, the earth drinks the water. Perkwunos hurled fire from the cloud. Perkwunos, split the cloud and give us rain! Father Sky, may it rain!

pie: h₁yód nébʰos kl̥Héni sédyeti h₂wérst. h₁yód h₃mígʰleh₂ liméni ḱéyor ne h₂wérst. n̥bʰrós péruns gʷm̥sḱéti h₂erh₃wóm-kʷe ḱéleti. h₂énh₁mos nébʰos wédʰeti.
english: When a cloud sits on the hill, it rains. When mist lies on the lake, it does not rain. The rain-cloud comes from the mountain and covers the arable land. The wind leads the cloud.

pie: h₃réǵ déḱm̥ gʷówes lelikʷḗr. nu tóns péruni h₂isḱóm. nu suHnús séh₂gyet tóns-kʷe déh₂newi widóm. nu septḿ̥ h₁éyes gʷíh₃wonti wĺ̥kʷos-kʷe tríns h₁íns gʷr̥h₃ét.
english: King, ten cattle are missing. I looked for them on the mountain. Then the son tracked, and I found them by the river. Seven are alive, and the wolf devoured three.

pie: n̥bʰróns gʷm̥dʰí. h₂erh₃wóy h₂wr̥syéh₁t. h₂énh₁mos gʷowsth₂óm mē Hrumpyéh₁t. ń̥bʰre litdʰí. sóh₂wl̥ lukyéh₁t.
english: Rain-cloud, come! May it rain on the arable land! May the wind not break the cow-stall. Rain-cloud, go away! May the sun shine bright.

pie: swésor h₂ówins h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. nu bʰréh₂ter wr̥h₁énes tetr̥pḗr. h₁íh₂n̥s h₂mélǵmi. h₂ólut bʰére. nu ǵénh₁tōr swesrés wókʷm̥ h₂wéyst.
english: Sister, milk the sheep! Brother, the lambs are sated. I am milking them. Bring the beer! The parent heard the sister's voice.

pie: dyḗws ph₂tḗr. dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr. n̥bʰrós diwés ǵénh₁mn̥. dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter h₂éle. dyéw ph₂ter wódr̥ dh₃dʰí. bʰóh₁ lewbʰóh₁.
english: Sky is father, Earth is mother. The rain-cloud is the offspring of Sky. Mother Earth, feed the cattle! Father Sky, give water! Both are dear.

pie: dyéw nos ph₂ter stéh₂dʰh₁om ph₂sdʰí. ǵʰwḗr h₂ówins mē lm̥bʰyéh₁t gʰóstis-wē h₁éḱwons mē stéh₂yoyh₁t. nu h₂éǵroy h₁édih₁t tr̥pyéh₁t-kʷe. nu nos wékʷos ḱludʰí.
english: Father Sky, protect our herd! May the beast not seize the sheep, nor a stranger steal the horses. May it eat in the pasture, and may it be sated. Hear our word!

pie: wíHrōs pérwr̥ gléwbʰete. tód gléwbʰete swidyómes. pérwr̥ Hrumptór mē h₃slidʰté.
english: Split the rock, men! Split it, we sweat. The rock breaks, do not slip!

pie: "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos.
english: "Let this be so," said the bright god Werunos.

pie: h₂óweyes sth₂éh₁yete h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m skindmés. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m ph₂wéni h₂sowséyete. nu yúH nogʷṓs.
english: Sheep, stand, we cut the wool. Dry the wool by the fire! Now you are naked.

pie: pótni wr̥h₁énes kú h₁sénti? nu wr̥h₁énes h₂éǵroy h₁sénti. h₁íns widóm h₁édn̥t-kʷe. nu suHnús h₁íns h₂lékseti. pótni gʷm̥dʰí nu h₁édomes.
english: Wife, where are the lambs? The lambs are in the pasture. I saw them, and they were eating. Then the son guards them. Come, wife, let us eat.

pie: h₂wést. nu poh₂imḗn stéh₂dʰh₁om h₂éǵrom h₁élh₂t. nu stéh₂dʰh₁om h₁ḗdt. nu sédt stéh₂dʰh₁om-kʷe spéḱyet. nu wĺ̥kʷom widét HréwdHt-kʷe h₁ím-kʷe h₁éǵʰs ǵʰéyt.
english: It dawned. Then the herdsman drove the herd to the pasture. The herd was eating. Then he sat down and kept looking at the herd. Then he saw the wolf and cried out, and drove it out.

pie: h₁yód n̥bʰrós h₁r̥sḱéti stéh₂dʰh₁om gʷowsth₂óm wédʰe. h₁yód nébʰos kl̥Héni sédyeti súHn̥s pérwr̥ mē h₂éǵes. h₁yód stuh₂rós h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti suHnúm ḱóymom wédʰe. h₁yód pérkʷunos bʰéh₂ti h₂Hséh₂i sddʰí.
english: When a rain-cloud arrives, lead the herd to the cow-stall. When a cloud sits on the hill, do not drive the pigs to the mountain. When a strong wind blows, lead the son home. When Perkwunos speaks, sit at the hearth.

pie: tod ḱeḱruwos owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: gʷówes sth₂éh₁yete gʷḗn h₂mélǵti. gʷówes dedh₃té wr̥h₁ḗn srobʰéyeti. mē bʰih₂té. gʷḗn muddʰí.
english: Stand, cattle, stand, the woman milks. Give, cattle, give, the lamb sips. Do not be afraid! Be joyful, woman!

pie: wíHrōs wédni déh₂nus bʰérete. swésor wódr̥ limnés bʰére. léymō stéwdt. gʰostéyey h₂ólut dh₃dʰí. mē h₃slidʰté. wéǵʰete.
english: Carry the water from the river, men! Sister, carry the water from the lake. The lake has become cold. Give beer to the guest! Do not slip! Keep carrying!

pie: h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ séngʷt h₁regʷesyéti. h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ nébʰesi séngʷt h₂énh₁mos gʷm̥yéti. témHos kl̥Héni ḱéyor. nókʷts stéwdt.
english: When the sun sinks, it grows dark. When the sun sinks into cloud, the wind comes. Darkness lies on the hill. The night grows cold.

pie: wíHrōs dukté wíHrōs stundté. kʷékʷlos wéndʰetor kʷékʷlos pró h₁éyti. ḱḗr stuh₂róm mē sth₂éh₁yete.
english: Pull, men, push, men! The wheel turns, the wagon goes forward. The heart is strong, do not stand still!

pie: súHnew bʰéwdʰe h₁regʷesyéti. stéh₂dʰh₁om spéḱye wókʷm̥ ḱléwse. mē légʰs.
english: Be awake, son, be awake, it is getting dark. Look at the herd, listen to the voice! Do not lie down.

pie: owis eḱwoi kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses
